## Problem

What problem or requirement should the proposal address?

## Proposed approach

Describe the proposal and mark unresolved details as `OPEN`.

## Alternatives

What other approaches should be considered?

## Consequences

Describe compatibility, extensibility, security, implementation, and conformance implications.

## Supporting research

Link the relevant research, requirements, standards, and sources.

## Baseline check

- [ ] The proposal preserves the static and passive v0.1 baseline.
- [ ] It does not assume that the container or logical model has already been selected.
- [ ] It is clearly presented as a proposal rather than an accepted decision.
- [ ] If accepted, the substantive decision will be recorded in an ADR.
- [ ] It does not publish a potentially sensitive unpatched vulnerability.
